request.idea: They wake up and discover their town is floating in the clouds.

bible.title: A Patch Above the Clouds
bible.narrativeComplexity: a problem with a consequence the reader can connect
bible.userIdea: They wake up and discover their town is floating in the clouds.
bible.premise: When Mina and Maya wake, they discover their town floating on clouds. A rooftop sail can steer it, but learning to use it puts their home and rooftop garden at risk.
bible.hook: Beyond their bedroom window, the street ends in open sky.
bible.goal: Steer their drifting home through a clear gap before it reaches the storm.
bible.centralProblem: The town is drifting towards storm clouds, and the children do not yet know how its rooftop sail works.
bible.stakes: The storm could damage their home. Their first steering mistake already costs them most of their rooftop seedlings.
bible.motif: Two edges held together: quilt corners, sail ropes, and helping hands.

locations.name: their bedroom
locations.visualIdentity: Two beds, a round window, and a stair door; warm colours contrast with the sky outside.

locations.name: the roof garden
locations.visualIdentity: A low-walled rooftop with seedling trays and cloud-filled views beyond the surrounding houses.

locations.name: the sail deck
locations.visualIdentity: A raised wooden platform with a broad cloth sail, two control ropes, and rope cleats.

entities.name: the town
entities.identity: A cluster of houses and streets resting on one thick cloud; wind moves the whole cloud together.
entities.state: Level and safely beyond the storm, travelling through clear sky.

entities.name: the quilt

entities.state: Tied across the sail's tear.

entities.name: the roof sail

entities.state: Holding wind evenly with the quilt patch intact.

entities.name: the two ropes
entities.identity: Two ropes controlling opposite edges of the sail.
entities.state: Freed from the cleats and controlled together by the children.

entities.name: the rope cleats
entities.identity: Two wooden fittings that hold the steering ropes in position.
entities.state: Available to secure either control rope.

entities.name: the seedling tray
entities.identity: A shallow tray containing six small bean plants in loose soil.
entities.state: Set securely beside the inner wall, with the surviving seedling replanted.

entities.name: the storm clouds
entities.identity: A dark bank of clouds with a narrow clear gap along one edge.
entities.state: Ahead of the drifting town, with a clear gap along its edge.
